pm.staerke.heim: Expected to be strong at home
pm.text.pflichtsieg: Beating %1 is a must: they sit in position %2 and you want to go up. Anything else is a setback.
pm.text.favorit: You go into the game against %1 as favourites. The team should control it.
pm.text.offen: Against %1 everything is open. Small things decide.
pm.text.aussenseiter: %1 are clearly stronger. A point would be a success; patience and discipline count.
pm.text.derby: Derby against %1: table and form count for little, effort and passion decide.
pm.hinweis.ton.warm: Lifts the team. Good after defeats, weak as a driver before a must-win.
pm.hinweis.ton.sachlich: Calm and clear. Little risk, little spark.
pm.hinweis.ton.bestimmt: Demands effort. Good for a must-win and derbies, less so after a winning run.
pm.hinweis.ton.hart: Puts on pressure. Only works against complacency, otherwise unsettles.
pm.hinweis.ton.ausweichend: Takes the tension out. Helps with nerves, costs bite.
pm.hinweis.ziel.sieg: Demands the win. Fits favourites, unrealistic against a clear favourite.
pm.hinweis.ziel.punkt: A point is enough. Fits underdogs, underwhelms ambitious players as favourites.
pm.hinweis.ziel.einsatz: Effort over result. Safe, but without a spark.
pm.hinweis.fokus.gegner: Adapts to the opponent's strengths. Good as underdogs.
pm.hinweis.fokus.eigen: Concentrates on your own game. Good as favourites.

pm.satz.sehr_gut: %1 is fired up for the game.
pm.halten.grund: Choose tone, goal and focus first.
